blocks.html: The product collection to create or update.

types.name: id
types.description:
The ID of the product collection to update. If not provided,
the product collection is created. In this case, the `title` property is
required.

types.name: value
types.description: The value of the product collection.

types.name: title
types.description: The title of the product collection.

types.name: handle
types.description: The handle of the product collection.

types.name: product_ids
types.description: The IDs of the products to associate with the product collection.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
